scope: Optimistic perfect-region-selection CPU S0; no learned lineage or training authorization
exact_repair: All 16 eligible-host combinations crossed with all 24 permutations of the four existing priority ranks; all outside decisions fixed. Best feasible retained.
region_pool: 96 deterministic sampled connected mixed-precedence/resource regions plus 32 uniformly sampled distinct four-operation regions
control: Prior calibration-selected compiled joint_greedy with full 250 ms, including common baseline; worst of three repeats
start: Same joint_greedy limited to 140 ms, including common baseline; worst of three repeats
oracle: Best of all 128 exact repairs of the fixed partial start and the full-budget control. Selection is free: an optimistic feasibility bound only within this finite pool and serving recipe.
advance_timing: Every repeated winning repair plus the partial start and pool construction plus 10 ms selector reserve must fit 250 ms
live_gate: All four inputs times partial start, full-budget control, best repaired region: 12 live runs regardless of outcome; independently check every operation.
next_if_pass: Fresh sixteen-input qualification with equal-budget hand region selectors and 1/2/4-hop nonlocal residual controls; no training from S0 alone.
next_if_fail: Stop this four-operation finite-pool serving recipe; do not extrapolate to all larger-region repairs or the true optimum.
